Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Laleli and Ortaköy are in the same neighborhood (or confused the hierarchy of neighborhoods and districts). The search results clearly show the Laleli Mosque is in the "Laleli" neighborhood of the "Fatih" district, while the Esma Sultan Mansion is in the "Ortaköy" neighborhood of the "Beşiktaş" district. Since they are in different neighborhoods (Laleli vs. Ortaköy) and even different districts (Fatih vs. Beşiktaş), the answer "no" is correct, but the Planner's reasoning that they are in the same district/neighborhood is factually wrong. The Planner failed to correctly interpret the administrative boundaries provided in the search results.
